# sts (sts.origincloudapis.eu)

Guide: <https://docs.origincloud.eu/docs/iam/workload-identity-federation/index.html.md>
Commands: `origin sts <command>`. Add `--output json` to every command whose output you read.

- **SecurityTokenService**: The security token service: it turns a token from an identity provider outside Origin Cloud, such as a CI job's OIDC token, into the access token of a `WORKLOAD` service account that trusts it through a federated credential.

## Commands

### `origin sts assume-service-account`

Assumes a `WORKLOAD` service account with an OIDC token.

```sh
origin sts assume-service-account --oidc-token-file <PATH>
```

Also: `--organization <ORGANIZATION>`, `--service-account <SERVICE_ACCOUNT>`, `--lifetime <DURATION>`

- no MCP tool: Assuming a service account answers with its access token; a tool would put working credentials into the model's context, and an agent already has its own. CI jobs assume one through the SDKs and the CLI.
